business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

coverage_item_or_resource.description: Immutable item or resource whose requirement and eligible coverage were reconciled.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

dose_amount_unit.description: Unit of the derived dose amount (mg or g).

doses_in_scope.description: Administrations in scope for this stocking decision.

earliest_qualified_base_slot.description: First non-displacing chair session on or after standard drug readiness (ISO date).

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

expedite_completion_days_saved.description: Days the expedited shipment saves after the chair calendar is reapplied.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Meridian's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on MB-55207.

external_recovery_quantity.description: Uncovered VIAL that the external recovery must cover.

ineligible_coverage_quantity.description: lot 8790 vials quarantined after the refrigerator alarm

observed_coverage_quantity.description: Gross observed coverage for dispensable IVIG-10G vials at the infusion pharmacy before exclusions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit shared by the requirement and coverage calculations: VIAL.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing standard_delivery_plan, expedite_supplier_shipment, borrow_vials_from_partner_hospital.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

required_dose_amount.description: Dose per administration derived from the ordered g/kg and the current measured weight.

required_quantity.description: 10 g vials required for one 1 g/kg administration at the 2026-03-06 weight of 70 kg

selected_chair_session.description: Chair and session used by the selected option, as CHAIR/YYYY-MM-DD/SESSION.

shortage_quantity.description: Uncovered VIAL after netting eligible coverage from the requirement.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Meridian's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on MB-55207.

usable_coverage_quantity.description: Net eligible coverage after removing lot 8790 vials quarantined after the refrigerator alarm.

vials_per_dose.description: Whole vials per administration after the formulary rounding rule.

calculations.description: Preserved 2026-03-16 as the documented control date for Kwame Boateng's IVIG induction; did not infer urgency from a title or a request tone.
Derived 7 VIAL for 10 g vials required for one 1 g/kg administration at the 2026-03-06 weight of 70 kg at revision v1.
Read 9 VIAL of gross observed dispensable IVIG-10G vials at the infusion pharmacy.
Excluded 4 VIAL for lot 8790 vials quarantined after the refrigerator alarm.
Calculated 9 observed − 4 ineligible = 5 usable VIAL.
Calculated 7 required − 5 usable = 2 VIAL uncovered.
Kept every planning quantity in VIAL.
Calculated standard_delivery_plan outcome as 2026-03-20 under regular chair sessions that do not displace protected patients.
Calculated expedite_supplier_shipment outcome as 2026-03-13 using Meridian's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on MB-55207.
Calculated borrow_vials_from_partner_hospital outcome as 2026-03-11 and kept its separate-approval condition.
Read 2026-03-20 as the independently confirmed standard readiness date for Meridian's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on MB-55207.
Read 2026-03-13 as the independently confirmed expedited readiness date for Meridian's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on MB-55207.
Bound external recovery to the 2 VIAL uncovered requirement rather than ordering the full header quantity.
Calculated 1 g/kg × 70 kg (2026-03-06 weight) = 70 g for the single-day administration.
Kept the derived dose in g.
Converted 70 g into 7 single-use 10 g vials.
Kept one administration in scope; the every-4-weeks maintenance is a later stocking decision.
Identified 2026-03-20 (CHAIR-3 AM) as the first free session on or after the 2026-03-20 standard readiness.
Bound the expedited plan to CHAIR-1/2026-03-13/PM, the first free session on or after the 2026-03-13 expedited readiness.
Compared the expedited 2026-03-13 chair date with the standard 2026-03-20 date: expediting saves 7 days and is the only authorized path inside the control date.
Applied USD 180 as the documented incremental cost for expedite_supplier_shipment; did not invent a premium where spend is not a decision driver.
Recognized that borrow_vials_from_partner_hospital remains outside current authority and requires an additional approval.

Compared the timing, cost, control status, and consequence of standard_delivery_plan, expedite_supplier_shipment, borrow_vials_from_partner_hospital; selected expedite_supplier_shipment because it alone gives the best currently authorized result under drug readiness versus the non-displacing chair calendar.
Calculated 2026-03-13 as the supported outcome date for expedite_supplier_shipment.
Compared 2026-03-13 with the independent control date 2026-03-16 and calculated a signed variance of -3 day(s).
Reported ON_TIME; did not relabel a controlled but late result as on time.

facts.rubric: Located IVIG-10G using immutable identifiers and preserved effective revision v1: MRN-604118 resolves to Patient PAT-10933 and active order MR-70455; Ama Boateng's completed ITP course (MR-70430) is a different patient and regimen.
facts.statement: CLIN-0004: MRN-604118 resolves to Patient PAT-10933 and active order MR-70455; Ama Boateng's completed ITP course (MR-70430) is a different patient and regimen; the effective revision is v1.

facts.rubric: Applied the effective order and policy to establish 7 VIAL for 10 g vials required for one 1 g/kg administration at the 2026-03-06 weight of 70 kg, with control date 2026-03-16.
facts.statement: The effective order and policy establish 10 g vials required for one 1 g/kg administration at the 2026-03-06 weight of 70 kg = 7 VIAL: the order is 1 g/kg at the 2026-03-06 weight of 70 kg, so one administration needs 70 g = 7 vials. The control date is 2026-03-16 (Dr. Lindqvist: dose by Monday 2026-03-16 because weakness is progressing).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 9 observed less 4 excluded to 5 supported VIAL for dispensable IVIG-10G vials at the infusion pharmacy.
facts.statement: the on-hand workbook shows 9 IVIG-10G vials in gross; lot 8790 (4 vials) is quarantined after the 2026-03-01 alarm, so 5 vials are dispensable; eligibility requires netting the exclusions rather than trusting a header total.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-03-13 expedited readiness input for expedite_supplier_shipment, then separately derived its 2026-03-13 operating outcome under drug readiness versus the non-displacing chair calendar instead of treating a supplier promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Meridian's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on MB-55207: Meridian MB-55207 confirms standard delivery 2026-03-19 and expedited 2026-03-12 (+USD 180); shelf release is the next clinic day after receipt; a supplier confirmation alone proves neither eligibility nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied regular chair sessions that do not displace protected patients to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked sessions.
facts.statement: regular chair sessions that do not displace protected patients: the first free session on or after 2026-03-13 is CHAIR-1 PM on 2026-03-13; on or after 2026-03-20 it is CHAIR-3 AM on 2026-03-20; CHAIR-2 AM on 2026-03-16 is protected; protected and blocked sessions cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-CO-0104 only to expedite_supplier_shipment and IVIG-10G; kept borrow_vials_from_partner_hospital outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-CO-0104 covers one Meridian order up to 3 vials with an expedite fee up to USD 200; partner loans and release of lot 8790 need the pharmacy director. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize borrow_vials_from_partner_hospital.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected expedite_supplier_shipment: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies drug readiness versus the non-displacing chair calendar.
facts.statement: neurology needs the dose by 2026-03-16 and will otherwise escalate; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside drug readiness versus the non-displacing chair calendar.

options.consequence: standard delivery plan waits for Meridian's 2026-03-19 run, shelf 2026-03-20, first free session 2026-03-20 (CHAIR-3 AM); it costs nothing but lands 4 days after the neurology control date.
options.label: standard_delivery_plan: outcome 2026-03-20, incremental cost USD 0, FEASIBLE_WITH_INFERIOR_TRADEOFF

options.consequence: expedite supplier shipment brings 2 vials by 2026-03-12, shelf 2026-03-13, and the free CHAIR-1 PM session on 2026-03-13 dispenses the full 70 g three days before the control date for USD 180, inside AP-CO-0104.
options.label: expedite_supplier_shipment: outcome 2026-03-13, incremental cost USD 180, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: borrow vials from partner hospital would dose on 2026-03-11 (CHAIR-2 PM) for a USD 60 courier, 2 days earlier, but inter-facility loans need the pharmacy director and the partner agreement, which AP-CO-0104 does not carry.
options.label: borrow_vials_from_partner_hospital: outcome 2026-03-11, incremental cost USD 60, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED

decision_model.recommendation_reason: expedite_supplier_shipment is the best currently authorized response that satisfies drug readiness versus the non-displacing chair calendar and lands 3 day(s) on or before the control date.

instruction: Neurology is pushing to get Kwame Boateng's IVIG in quickly because his weakness is progressing. Dr. Lindqvist's order is weight-based and pharmacy tells me part of our immune globulin is sitting in quarantine after the fridge alarm. I need to know how much the order really needs, how much of what we hold can actually be used, whether Meridian's standard or expedited delivery gets us there in time for the date neurology gave, and what borrowing from the partner hospital would involve. Place the order that is actually approved, then draft the update for neurology and scheduling.
